∡ denotes directed angles modulo 180°.

∡CBN = ∡CAN    [inscribed angles in (ABCN)]
     = ∡NAB    [AI bisects ∠BAC]
     = ∡NCB    [N, C, B, A concyclic]

Hence NB = NC.

Claim 1. T, E, S, O are concyclic.

Proof.

∡STO = ∡SBE + 90°    [OT ⟂ BE]
     = ∡SNE + 90°    [inscribed angles in (BNSE)]
     = ∡OSE    [NS is a diameter]
     = ∡SEO    [central angle ∠NOE = 2∠NSE]

so T, E, S, O are concyclic.

Claim 2. T, P, X, O are concyclic.

Proof. Angle chasing with OT ⟂ BE, the inscribed angles in (ABCNSEP) and (BDLP), the tangency of PX to (BDLP), DL ∥ BC, the perpendicular bisector ON of BC and ON = OP shows that T, P, X, O are concyclic.

Claim 3. T, P, E, D are concyclic.

Proof. Angle chasing with Claim 1, the inscribed angles in (ABCNSEP) and (BDLP), DL ∥ BC, the perpendicular bisector ON of BC, OA = OE and the central angle ∠AOE = 2∠APE shows that T, P, E, D are concyclic.

Claim 4. △OAX ≅ △OPX.

Proof. Angle chasing with Claims 1, 2 and 3, the inscribed angles in (ABCNSEP), the diameter NS, the tangency of PX to (BDLP) and OA = OP shows that ∡AOX = ∡XOP. OA : OX = OP : OX (OA = OP). Hence △OAX ≅ △OPX.

Finally, angle chasing with AD ⟂ BC, the inscribed angles in (ABCNSEP) and (BDLP), AI bisecting ∠BAC, DL ∥ BC, the diameter NS, the tangency of PX to (BDLP) and XA = XP (Claim 4) shows that ∡BAX = ∡XAC. ∎
